name: large-file-pagination
prompt: audit.log contains exactly one FATAL line. Find it and write its error code (the value of code=) into a file called INCIDENT.txt, containing just the code.
notes: The target sits at line 3607 of 4200, well past the 2000-line read ceiling. A harness whose read tool truncates without saying how to continue loses this task outright; one whose grep works finds it in a single call. The turn budget is the real measurement here, not the pass.
